facts.text: Every Occidental student completes a senior comprehensive project, known as a comp, before graduating.

sources.title: Senior Comps | Occidental College
sources.quote: Every student completes a senior comprehensive project, or “comp,” designed to showcase what you've accomplished over the last four years.

facts.text: Under the Occidental Affordability Promise, families with typical assets and income under $150,000 pay no tuition, while those earning between $150,000 and $250,000 pay half tuition.

sources.title: Affordability at Oxy | Occidental College
sources.quote: Families with a total income under $150,000 with typical assets pay no tuition. Families with a total income between $150,000-$250,000 with typical assets pay half tuition.
